remarks: Completely reimagined behind the private gates of Calabasas Park Estates, this sophisticated Mediterranean estate offers a refined blend of timeless architecture and contemporary design. With five bedrooms and six bathrooms, the residence has been thoughtfully renovated throughout with wide-plank French oak floors, elevated finishes, and an effortless sense of flow. At the center of the home, the chef's kitchen features custom shaker cabinetry, top-of-the-line appliances, quartz countertops, a herringbone backsplash, and an oversized waterfall island with bar seating.
